topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture series with a welcome, course framing across disciplines, and the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Biological Basis of Cancer: Genetic Alterations and Differentiation Failure
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the accumulation of genetic and epigenetic changes disrupts normal developmental programs, differentiation, and tissue architecture.

topics.label: Invasion, Metastasis, and the Benign-to-Malignant Transition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the defining characteristics of benign versus malignant tumors, illustrating stepwise progression and tissue invasion through histological examples.

topics.label: Nomenclature of Benign and Malignant Neoplasms
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the standard naming conventions and clinical exceptions used to classify tumors based on their tissue origin and malignant behavior.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Disease and Mortality in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the systemic and organ-specific physiological processes through which primary and metastatic tumors cause illness and death.

topics.label: Tumor Incidence across Tissues and Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the frequency of different cancer types in human populations and compare tumor patterns across multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Principles and Clinical Application of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss clinical presentation signs and evaluate the effectiveness, methods, and limitations of population screening across major tumor types.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Revision Reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by referencing the core learning outcomes and upcoming practical sessions.
